mapper.select: SELECT W.WAIT_NUMBER AS waitNumber, W.SPACE_NUMBER AS spaceNumber, W.MEDICAL_NUMBER AS medicalNumber, W.STANDBY_STATE AS standbyState, W.WAITING_TURN_NUMBER AS waitingTurnNumber, W.HOLD_REASON AS holdReason, W.EXPECTED_WAITING_TIME AS expectedWaitingTime, W.ESTIMATED_TIME_REQUIRED AS estimatedTimeRequired, R.PATIENT_NUMBER AS patientNo, P.NAME AS patientName, R.EMPLOYEE_CODE AS employeeCode, E.EMPLOYEE_NAME AS employeeName, R.DEPT_CODE AS deptCode, R.RECEIPT_STATUS AS receiptStatus, R.RECEIPT_DATE AS receiptDate FROM WAIT W LEFT JOIN RECEPTIONIST_REGISTER R ON W.MEDICAL_NUMBER = R.MEDICAL_NUMBER LEFT JOIN PATIENT P ON R.PATIENT_NUMBER = P.PATIENT_NUMBER LEFT JOIN EMPLOYEE E ON R.EMPLOYEE_CODE = E.EMPLOYEE_CODE ORDER BY W.WAITING_TURN_NUMBER ASC
